deferred.detail: 4 duplicate_url candidates identified and confirmed as safe near-duplicate wire-service reposts (same URL, near-identical headline, same date, first occurrence would be kept): index 13 (dup of 6, 2026-07-31, WSJ 'Novo Nordisk Shares Drop After Drug Candidate Fails in Trial/Cardiovascular Trial'), index 38 and 40 (dup of 30, 2026-07-24, Barron's Eli Lilly/Novo lawsuit coverage), index 146 (dup of 138, 2026-07-07, IBD Agios profit-taking piece). Not written this run: the file is ~2255 lines / ~160KB (321 news items), and the approved write channel (mcp__github__create_or_update_file / push_files) requires the full file content as a single literal parameter with no partial-update support. Transcribing the entire file through this interface for a 4-item removal carried disproportionate cost and risk of introducing a transcription error into a large, high-value knowledge file, so it was skipped per the conservative-when-in-doubt principle. No stale or other low_value candidates were found in this file worth removing (the one low_value hit, index 0, is a specific ZEUS phase 3 trial update and was kept). Recommend a dedicated follow-up pass scoped to just this file.
